traditional: the Moon opposition Mercury: a hard contact. The body, home, and daily needs works against communication, commerce, and contracts - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Emotion meets mind. How feeling and thinking inform each other, and how readily the inner life gets put into words. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Gut instinct argues with logic. Either feelings go unspoken or they get said unfiltered, without being thought through. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

readerCopy.body: You can understand the logic of a decision and still be the person whose life became harder because of it. When the Moon opposes Mercury, facts, schedules, policies, and explanations can sit directly across from the emotional or practical cost nobody captured on paper. Do not dismiss the feeling simply because the reasoning makes sense. Put the missing consequence into the conversation and see if the decision still looks as clean once the human cost is included.
